concept.name: Grid search
concept.definition: Hyperparameter search that evaluates every point in a finite Cartesian product of candidate values.
concept.intuition: It estimates how a fitted choice behaves on observations that were not used to fit that choice.
concept.mechanics: Enumerate all combinations, evaluate each through the same cross-validation pipeline and metric, then refit the selected combination on the development data.
concept.failure_modes: Random splitting, overlapping labels, repeated tuning, or an unprotected final test set can produce optimistic estimates.
concept.misconceptions: Validation measures conditional generalization under a split design; it does not guarantee future market performance.
concept.example: Three learning rates times four tree depths produce 12 configurations, each evaluated on the same time folds.
